claims.claim: REPAIR source artifacts and readers bind Issue or delivery identity to authenticated GitHub run attempts, preserving correction selectors and actors while rejecting substitutions and ambiguous mappings.
Attempt readers expose bounded job/step identities, workflow status, strongest observed failures, typed causes and detail availability, separately from Runtime RUN attribution.

Safe FAILURE detail preserves ordered failed commands, bounded sanitized test identities, error classes, available counts and incomplete-observation flags while withholding parameters and raw diagnostics.
Completion and native failure projections distinguish observed structural causes, missing acceptance claims and final-response shapes, retaining UNKNOWN for unobserved causes.

Brain Sync, Unified State, Attention and Work Context compose validated source-bound diagnostics through bounded selectors, with typed blockers, privacy allowlists and exact protected-source digest checks.
Existing manual, AUTO and executorless eligibility, dispatch idempotency and correction-SHA gates remain in place; added diagnostic readers do not dispatch or create lifecycle records.

First-party regression fixtures exercise production consumers for the specified pre-RUN job shape, multi-command verification, incomplete observations, completion/native failures, malformed fixtures and adversarial or unavailable sources.

Corrected two stale test expectations after digest-matched local diagnosis and exact reproduction. Tests distinguish safe_detail from forbidden raw detail and coherent forged origins from inconsistent bindings, retaining adversarial rejection. All 14 cases passed directly; focused pytest reported 14 passed but exited 1 on xdist profile consistency. Canonical verification remains Runtime-owned. The repair is committed as a clean descendant of the exact failed head.
